turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, private banking, Daniel Reed speaking. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hello Daniel, it's Julia Mercer. I'm calling to finish the instruction after reading through the paperwork independently. I've set it beside me so I can keep the conversation focused. My identification number is S three six seven three two zero eight Q. My date of birth is the eleventh of August nineteen eighty-four.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Julia. I have the paperwork available as well. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak, or would you prefer a little time to settle in?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'm at my desk and can speak freely. I've just come back from a meeting about the community arts project, so it's rather pleasant to sit somewhere quiet.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: How is the project coming along? You mentioned that the consultancy was helping with the presentation materials.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The artists have sent their work through, and we're arranging the display boards. It's been enjoyable working on something outside our usual commercial briefs. There are quite a few opinions to bring together, though.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: It sounds like a busy collaboration. I won't keep you away from it unnecessarily. We can turn to the business of your call whenever you're ready.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've put the project notes away now. The fund I want to transact in is Orion Global Income Fund.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Let me read back the fund for your instruction: Nova Technology Equity Fund.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No, that is not the fund I specified. My instruction is for Orion Global Income Fund.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I apologise for that error. Thank you for catching it. I recommend buying Orion Global Income Fund.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'll bear that in mind. Before we get into the remaining details, could we keep the account correspondence concise? I read everything, but long covering messages make it harder to find what needs my attention.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note your preference for brief covering messages with a clear subject line. The accompanying documents would remain separate, rather than being reproduced in the message. Would that arrangement be practical?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: That would be useful. I don't need a conversational introduction each time. A clear heading and a short explanation of what the attachment is will help me file it alongside the relevant correspondence.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that communication preference. Turning back to the paperwork, there are disclosures to cover before the remaining instruction details. The transaction fee is 0.5%. You may lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You have the paperwork beside you, so I'll leave a moment for you to find the relevant section before we continue.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I've found it. Please place the transaction in euros. The amount I am committing to this transaction is 250,000. I want to buy the units. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The proposed quantity shown in the paperwork is 1,000 units.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please use the quantity you just proposed for my order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With the product reference corrected, please confirm your final instruction: buy 1,000 units of Orion Global Income Fund for 250,000 euros, using a market order.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I confirm that final instruction. Please proceed with the transaction.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Julia. That concludes the telephone instruction. Please retain your paperwork with the subsequent account correspondence. Is there anything else administrative that you wanted to discuss?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Nothing else today. The correspondence preference was the only other thing on my list. Thank you for keeping the call focused.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: You're welcome. I hope the preparations for the arts project go smoothly. Thank you for calling, and enjoy the rest of your afternoon.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Daniel. Goodbye.
